categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Kelin Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new power system sector, focusing on digital intelligent sensing products for power grids, energy storage systems, and perovskite photovoltaic modules. The company also provides power-related technical services and has extended into robot six-dimensional force sensors. Its product portfolio covers the entire power chain including generation, transmission, transformation, and distribution across various voltage levels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as intelligent sensing, AI-driven fault diagnosis algorithms, digital twin platforms, and perovskite photovoltaic manufacturing techniques including magnetron sputtering, vacuum evaporation, and atomic layer deposition. It employs modular design and system integration for energy storage, and develops multi-physical field sensing technologies for power equipment monitoring. Production is mostly made-to-order with ISO9001 quality management certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major power grid companies such as State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, as well as engineering contractors and industrial clients in the energy sector. The company serves the electric power industry with products and solutions for grid digitization, energy storage, and photovoltaic applications, targeting both domestic and provincial markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant market presence in East China (notably Zhejiang province), North China, Central China, South China, Southwest China, Northwest China, and Northeast China. It has expanded its energy storage projects beyond Zhejiang province to other key regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Kelin Electric operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and integrating intelligent sensing devices, energy storage systems, and photovoltaic modules. It also provides technical services and system integration solutions, positioning itself as a technology-driven equipment and service provider within the power grid ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in digital intelligent sensing for power grids, energy storage system integration, and perovskite photovoltaic technology. It emphasizes innovation in AI-based fault diagnosis, digital twin modeling, and flexible photovoltaic cells. Strategic initiatives include expanding into new energy and robotics markets, enhancing product competitiveness, and accelerating commercialization of perovskite photovoltaic modules and large-scale energy storage projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of intelligent sensing devices, energy storage systems, and photovoltaic modules. Additional income streams include power-related technical services such as research projects, software development, implementation, and product maintenance. The company also earns revenue from energy storage station operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hangzhou Kelin Electric is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a leader in power grid digital sensing technology in China. It holds international leading core technologies and participates in national standard setting. The company is positioned in the first tier of the perovskite photovoltaic industry and is expanding into emerging markets like robotics. It competes with other domestic and international power equipment and new energy technology providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 541 million, a 168% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by growth in energy storage business. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose 54.7% to about RMB 73 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.15 billion, up 21.9%, with net assets of RMB 892 million. The company maintains a strong growth trajectory supported by increased R&D investment and expanding market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly reliable, real-time, multi-dimensional intelligent sensing solutions that enable predictive maintenance and fault diagnosis for power equipment, enhancing grid safety and efficiency. Its perovskite photovoltaic modules feature industry-leading efficiency and flexible applications. The integration of AI, digital twin, and edge computing technologies differentiates its products by providing advanced analytics and operational optimization. Comprehensive after-sales service and close customer collaboration further strengthen its competitive advantage.
